events.what: Mihăilescu's preprint claims that (x^p+y^p)/(x+y) = p^e z^q has no coprime solutions for distinct odd primes p>3, q, and hence that x^p+y^p=z^q has none for that signature family
events.credibility_reason: The author is an established cyclotomic specialist (the record names him as the Catalan prover), but the claim settles a whole infinite two-parameter family of signatures (p,p,q), far beyond known modular-method results. It is a single-author preprint, and the record shows no expert uptake yet.

events.what: A survey reports Sikora's search extended to z^r ≤ 2^100, finding only the ten known solutions
Sikora proposes conjectural product generalisations of Fermat–Catalan

judgement.doubts: The codes stand. The partial result rests on an unreviewed single-author preprint whose claim is unusually strong for this problem. If it is rebutted, the status should revert to open. The 2^100 search counts only as instances.

corrections.why: other: The status is kept. The (p,p,q) family is a genuine restriction of the bullet's equation (a case, not a variant), so it counts. But the claim is unreviewed and very strong for the field, so it is credible only with doubt, and the status is fragile if the preprint fails.
